description: Natuurbranden is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by servicespub.risicokaart.nl. This dataset contains forest, heath or dune areas where a wildfire can occur. More information can be found at situations/nature fire. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal shows the English title as "Wildfires" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2019-06-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
